description: Make a blurry, small or old photo sharp and larger (AI upscaling). It can also restore faces, and clean scratches and dust from an old print. 5 free runs a day for each image tool, then 25 credits a run, charged only when the result is ready. Give the photo as file_id (the user uploads it through get_upload_link) or image_url. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

detail.description: How much fine texture to keep, 0 to 100: higher keeps more detail, lower removes more noise. Default 70.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the photo there.

image_url.description: Or a public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo. A result link from another YangOpen image tool works too.

restore_old_photo.description: Clean scratches, dust and peeling from an old print. Default false.

name: sharpen_image
title: Sharpen and enlarge a photo
